Missing interpretations:
Telescopes with NULL bandusagepct are excluded from the high-usage set, since NULL fails the cutoff comparison.

queries: SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct), COUNT(*) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct > 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus
SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct), COUNT(*) FROM telescopes WHERE bandusagepct >= 47.6 GROUP BY calibrstatus
SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct), SUM(CASE WHEN bandusagepct > 47.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM telescopes GROUP BY calibrstatus

SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(CASE WHEN bandusagepct > 47.6 THEN bandusagepct END) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY calibrstatus
SELECT calibrstatus, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count, CASE WHEN AVG(bandusagepct) > 47.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS high_usage_flag FROM telescopes GROUP BY calibrstatus

SELECT calibrstatus,
       CASE WHEN bandusagepct > (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) FROM telescopes) THEN 'Above' ELSE 'At or Below' END AS usage_group,
       AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage,
       COUNT(*) AS telescope_count
FROM telescopes
GROUP BY calibrstatus, usage_group;
